nom: Vichy LiftActiv Vitamin B3 Face Serum for Dark Spots & Wrinkles

avis.texte: Im 23, always looking for helpful ingredients for anti aging, texture and dark spots. I like the bottle and only been using it for a couple of days and dont like how it feels on my face. The touch of it is really greasey sitting on my face and i am only applying it once at night. I dont feel like it obsobers into the face and kinda just sits on it with fresh clean skin. Im not a fan maybe for others it works i do love different benfits of it in one serum.
Tightens, dimensions spots, and makes my skin glow and causes my make tightens to so much better and last all day.
I've been using this product for 7 months on two little dark spots, and they are going no where.

avis.titre: Yes going to other products as well
avis.texte: Can't wait to try other products already seeing results from this wonderful product . My dark spots are fading
Great product. Literally you can wear it under makeup and it won't feel heavy on you. VICHY is a good brand.

I received a sample of this product from Ulta and quickly noticed results, so i bought the full sized bottle. I love the product and will purchase again and again. There is no smell which i like. The only downfall is the weird dropper/ applicator thingy. It took me forever to figure out how to use it and its really iust inconvenient and awkward to use.

Definitely feels like it works and it works very quickly. I tried the deluxe sample and ordered it right away. I am 34 and starting to get slight dark spots on my skin, this serum was amazing. I can see this being a staple.

I don't see any improvement in my skin while using this product. I'm very religious with skin care routine and have been for a few years. I'm 29 with dry, sensitive skin. My goals are to stop signs of aging before they start showing up and to help even out texture due to dry skin. I notice poor skin texture while using this product and a lot of red and sensitive areas. My pores are very large while using this product too. It's one redeeming quality is that my skin feels soft to the touch but that doesn't make up for how my skin looks while using this. It was sent to me as a free gift so I have absolutely no bias. I wouldn't recommend this to anyone. Again I do have sensitive dry skin so maybe others with different skin textures and needs have had better responses.

I received a sample of this and used it on my face two nights ago. I'm not sure if I had an allergic reaction or it just broke me out very badly but I woke up with tiny red bumps all over my face and chest. I've never had any issues with their other products but I certainly cannot recommend this. My skin was completely clear and smooth before this and now I don't know when it will recover.
